statistics.estimator: geometric mean of paired ratios; equal weight per inferential session
statistics.bootstrap: paired log-ratio resampling within session; percentile intervals with linear interpolation
statistics.improvement: two-sided 95% interval wholly below 1.0; confirmation geometric mean below 1.0
statistics.noninferiority: one-sided 95% upper bound <= 1.03; confirmation geometric mean <= 1.03
statistics.regression: one-sided 95% lower bound > 1.03; confirmation geometric mean > 1.03
statistics.confirmation: predeclared fourth session, excluded from interval; never replaced after failure
statistics.order: alternate candidate/reference order; freeze all sample counts and endpoints before candidate results
statistics.violations: quality, memory, cache-path, route, cohort or workspace violation invalidates the pair
statistics.inconclusive: separately registered replication; never extend until passing

timing.resident: one declared stream/queue; one event/timestamp region around 32 serial operations; divide by 32
timing.public: one public call including preparation and one completion synchronization/fence
timing.preparation: restore declared fresh/prepared state outside timing; report conversion/quantization separately
timing.before_trial: drain prior work outside timing; keep input loading, hashing and output validation untimed
timing.device_clock: use reported clock period/valid bits; reject invalid/unavailable timing, never substitute wall time
timing.host_gaps: device intervals include any host submission gaps; never label them summed active-kernel time
